Title: Crypto Currency Application in Flutter
Description: Introducing Bull Currency - Your Crypto Info App. Real-time market data for coins from Coingecko and NewsApi, stored in Firebase and Sqflite. Track portfolio, wishlist coins, latest news, USD to INR converter, AI chatbots, Trading View charts, and feedback for continuous improvement. The ultimate tool for crypto enthusiasts!

Title: MovieHub
Description: Presenting MovieHub - Your Movie and Series Info Companion. With Firebase authentication and OMDB REST API integration, MovieHub allows you to explore comprehensive movie and series details conveniently. Backend Hive storage ensures secure access to your saved information, making it the perfect app for cinephiles seeking in-depth entertainment insights. Enjoy a seamless experience with MovieHub on the go!

Title: Apple Maps+ in SwiftUI
Description: An IOS application developed in both SWIFT and SWIFTUI. (2 Applications)  The Apple Maps applications that use  Apple  Maps to navigate and search across the world's locations allow users to get location-specific information like latitude, longitude, and city name. The user can save their favorite address information in the Coredata database and access it from another favorite address page.

Title: Inter Connect in SwiftUI
Description: Discover a user-friendly iOS app with integrated Apple Maps, Facebook, and Google login. Easily store and access your map locations using Core-Data. Enjoy the convenience of dark and light modes and smoothly navigate through a complex scroll view. Effortlessly save locations to the database with a long-press gesture.

Title: Media Share in Flutter
Description: MediaShare, the social media app built with Flutter and seamlessly integrated with Firebase. Discover a captivating world of photos, videos, and other media content, shared by users from all walks of life. With Firebase authentication, joining this creative community is as easy as a few taps, ensuring a secure and hassle-free login experience.

Title: Wake Note in Flutter
Description: This Mobile Application is used to schedule a notification to remind the user for doing their task even in app foreground & background as well.

Title: Expense Tracker in SwiftUI
Description: SwiftUI Expense Tracker is a simple and intuitive app that helps users record daily expenses. Users can add, filter, and view expenses with custom types and dates. It features clean UI, local state management, and interactive charts for quick insights.

Title: Itineery AI
Description: Itineery AI – Your Smart AI Travel Planner ✈️  Itineery AI is your ultimate AI-powered travel companion, designed to make trip planning effortless and personalized. Whether you're exploring a new city, planning a weekend getaway, or organizing a month-long adventure, Itineery AI helps you create the perfect itinerary in seconds.  Powered by advanced AI, Itineery AI acts like your personal travel agent, guiding you from inspiration to your actual journey — all inside a beautifully designed and easy-to-use app.
